pictures.author: VargaA
pictures.observations: Aerial from west: long narrow roofless stone core on an exposed ridge, damaged southwestern rounded end with tall broken points, longer palace walls and northeastern end wall. Construction platforms/tarps and vegetation obscure lower detail; temporary works are omitted.

pictures.author: Alekme
pictures.observations: Interior palace during conservation: deeply broken wall tops, thick pale irregular masonry, small open arched passage and sloping exposed rock floor. No complete roof, glazing or furnished rooms. Exact opening and conservation inventory remains approximate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific roofless Blatnica Castle core: narrow mapped ridge footprint, southwestern rounded jagged wall crown, long hollow palace walls and northeastern end, thick open window/door reveals, two low internal arch partitions and bounded exposed limestone ridge/court/short entrance approach. Three existing shared rubble-stone/raw-limestone/gravel graphs. No intact roofs, glass-filled ruins, copied sign/photo atlas, temporary construction platforms/tarps, separate shelter, whole mountain or invented complete lower bailey.
